[EN]
I never thought we would see this piece of history again. And it could not have been accomplished without Halran's translations of the echoes.

The mention of an elin is intriguing. There has only been one known elin in Northern Arun for decades.

Perhaps you can help us determine what the Echo Arcana means.
[ES] Nunca pensé que volveríamos a ver esta pieza de historia. Y no se habría podido lograr sin las traducciones de los ecos de Halran.
La mención de un elin es intrigante. Solo ha habido un elin conocido en Northern Arun durante décadas.

Tal vez puedas ayudarnos a determinar qué significa el Echo Arcana.
